]> 15/08/2026 7:23 Kickstarting the weekend with a bluebird!.

We're waking up to a chilly -5 degrees at Perisher this morning, with clear skies overhead. Today is shaping up to be mostly sunny with a top of 7 degrees and very little wind, making for a great day on the mountain.

The snowmaking team made the most of the cold overnight temperatures, firing the guns from 7:00pm last night right through to this morning. On the slopes, expect firm, fast conditions underfoot with a fresh layer of man-made snow on top.

With 40 lifts spinning and 62 groomed runs to explore, there's plenty of room to roam this sunny Saturday. There's also live music dotted around the resort: catch Car Kills Kiwi at Blue Cow, DJ Bolta at Mid-Station, and the Greg Nunan Duo and Vibe Band at Jax Bar.

Red Bull Sessions are also on today, bringing together passionate skiers and boarders for a day of riding, progression and good times alongside Australia's best Red Bull snow athletes, including Olympian Valentino Guseli. The Red Bull DJ Cat will be spinning tunes live from the top of Front Valley Park!

The Subaru Wilderness Scavenger Hunt is also underway. Four flags are hidden across the resort, and finding one wins you a Subaru Wilderness Prize Pack. Clues will be shared throughout the morning on social media, so follow @perisher_resort and @subaruaustralia on Instagram to track them down!

We also want to with good luck to everyone racing in the Perisher Masters today! Please note, racing will take place on Front Valley.

Have a great weekend on the slopes!
